skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Silent Night DN06
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Silent Night Series DN06. The material is light, soft, breathable and durable. The latest design that is as enchanting as it is elegant.
skins.quote: Yes, this is Mudrock, our young and beautiful Sarkaz lady.

skins.name: Rubble
skins.content: Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics/Rubble. For the explorer pursuing what remains. Made of special materials suited for all climates, meeting the harsh demands of complex environments.
skins.usage: One of Mudrock's special work outfits.
skins.quote: To the Children of Soil and Stone, decaying ruins can quickly become a set of Kazdelian houses.

skins.name: Obsidian
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Obsidian. Mudrock's work outfit. Mudrock made rounds between every facility at the venue, ensuring the performance would go without a hitch. Though working behind the scenes, she nevertheless opted for a disguise of sorts so as not to disturb the audience.
skins.quote: Most hotheaded troublemakers back off for their own safety, seeing the iron hammer she's carrying.
